description: Each iteration either gets a fresh environment or shares one. With fresh frames each captured value differs. With a shared frame all report the last value written.

steps.description: The Environment class with define, lookup, assign, and __repr__ for chain visualization.
run takes a flag: if True it creates a fresh frame per iteration, else all iterations share one frame. Each frame defines captured as the loop index.
